project: Wuxia Life P76 Renown Payoff Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for jianghu_renown_sage payoff phase — define the payoff direction (choice-based vs auto), 3 choice options, contract, and validation shape before implementation, preserving tavern-born flavor.

userStories.title: Audit renown payoff prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the renown payoff stage so P76 starts from the real gating surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing renown route flags, markers, events, and expressions (bridge + entry + on-ramp + pressure)
Identify what exists before payoff vs what can be reused
Save docs/test-reports/p76-renown-payoff-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Completed — 5 checkpoint flags, 4 stage markers, 3 spine events, 7 expression surfaces inventoried; upstream gate renown_midlife_pressure_done ready; payoff gaps documented

userStories.title: Lock P76 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P76 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P76 to gap audit, direction comparison, payoff contract, and proof shape only
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, new framework, bulk content wave, late-life design
Save docs/test-reports/p76-renown-payoff-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Completed — 4 allowed layers, 5 forbidden categories, 4 scope guardrails, NO-GO conditions, rollback strategy; zero runtime changes

userStories.title: Compare renown payoff directions (choice-based vs auto)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want payoff-direction options so P76 chooses the most differentiated and bounded payoff shape before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare at least 2 payoff modes: choice-based (how to repay favor debt?) vs auto (like merchant)
If choice-based selected, compare at least 3 choice directions (e.g. hold-on, break-free, find-balance)
Each candidate includes: core narrative, trigger conditions, player choice space, tavern-born fit, implementation complexity
Select recommended direction and document rejected alternatives
Recommendation follows quality-first and small-step principles
Save comparison document
userStories.notes: Completed — selected choice-based '人情债之解'; 3 directions: 硬扛到底(A) / 索性撕破脸(B) / 找到平衡(C); rejected auto payoff; all choices have distinct stats/identity/narrative; tavern-born flavor consistent

userStories.title: Define renown payoff contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit payoff contract so P77 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define payoff checkpoint, required flags, and corresponding gate acceptance
Define 1 core payoff event (choice-based or auto)
If choice-based, define stat changes, identity markers, and expression differences per choice
Define at least 3 payoff-specific player-facing signals
Clarify difference between payoff vs pressure and vs generic midlife
Preserve tavern-born flavor throughout
Reserve flag interfaces for subsequent late-life / endgame stages
Save contract to docs/PRD/p76-renown-payoff-contract.md
userStories.notes: Completed — contract LOCKED; choice-based '人情债之解' with 3 options; full event spec + 5 expression surfaces + gate acceptance criteria + reserved late-life flags; tavern-born flavor consistent

userStories.title: Define P77 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P77 validation shape fixed in advance so playable payoff work is judged against explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which chain nodes targeted proof must show (pressure → payoff → expression changes)
If choice-based, each choice direction must have core node verification
Define which assertions regression tests must cover at minimum
Define what evidence counts as payoff closed
No full lifetime exhaust required
Define regression boundaries for P71/P72/P73/P75 existing evidence
userStories.notes: Completed — 11 core + 5 bonus targeted proof nodes; ~25 regression tests across 7 groups; 9 closure criteria; P71/P72/P73/P75 regression boundaries; no full lifetime exhaust required

userStories.title: Produce P76 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the renown payoff design-first contract and hands off to P77.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p76-renown-payoff-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, payoff-direction comparison, payoff contract, validation shape
Clarify boundary with P77
List remaining deferred larger renown-expansion items
State GO / NO-GO for payoff implementation stage
userStories.notes: Completed — 6/6 stories passed; contract LOCKED; GO recommendation for P77; deferred items documented; P76/P77 boundary clear
